scope: Finite fixed source-derived RN binary32 controls; corpus qualification, not universal equivalence or implementation lineage

derivations.zero-y-axis: Positive X returns Y signed zero. Negative X returns signed source pi representative: Apple low 40490fda, Sun/modern high 40490fdb.
derivations.near-half-k70: Exact scale-invariant |y/x|=2^70. Apple/modern F64 half-pi offset rounds high. Sun k=70 shortcut z rounds high, but negative-X reconstruction pi-(z-low) rounds half-pi low.
derivations.zero-x-axis: All three return signed half-pi high 3fc90fdb independently of X zero sign.
derivations.equal-magnitude: Positive X gives signed pi/4 high 3f490fdb; negative X gives signed 3pi/4 4016cbe4. Sun id=1 reduction is exact zero.
derivations.zero-origin: Positive X zero returns signed Y zero; negative X zero selects each source pi representative with Y sign.
derivations.apple-ratio-2^-22-neighbor: Y words 347fffff,34800000,34800001 over |X|=1 bracket the <=2^-22 guard. Negative-X result rounds 40490fda for all sources on both branches. Positive-X atan(Y) rounds Y exactly.
derivations.sun-k60-neighbor: Y=3f000000 with |X|=207fffff,20800000,20800001 gives arithmetic-shift k=61,61,60. Shortcut versus atanf saturation both yield high half-pi before quadrant reconstruction; Sun negative-X result is low while Apple/modern are high.
derivations.basis-source-order: Frozen ordered F32 arithmetic from the pinned raymath header, evaluated with exact Fraction RN-even and signed zero; V3 corpus square roots are exact powers of two or positive zero. Line final negation toggles the scalar output sign bit. Changed atan2 input pairs are resolved only through independently frozen scalar expectations.

wrapper_controls.derivation: uncontracted-cancellation: exact product 1-2^-46 rounds to1 before determinant subtraction
